description: On May 14, SB 498, a New Hampshire Senate bill concerning mental health coverage for children 18 and younger, came before the House after passing the Senate. It was among the most widely discussed bills of the day. It passed only as interim study by a 188-164 division vote, and a subsequent motion to reconsider later
